docs.summary: Static context menu system for Origami. Only one context menu open at a time. Opens as a modal, so it sits above everything already open, other modals included. Use [`RightClickMenu`](#api~Prowl.OrigamiUI.ContextMenu~RightClickMenu) inside any element's scope to attach a right-click menu. Use [`Show`](#api~Prowl.OrigamiUI.ContextMenu~Show) to open programmatically at a position.

docs.summary: Attach a right-click context menu to the current parent element. Call this inside an element's Enter() scope.
Call once per frame to reset dedup state. The actual rendering is done by the modal system.

docs.summary: Render a static, inline `.w2menu` panel in the current layout flow (for showcases / documentation). Mirrors [`Preview`](#api~Prowl.OrigamiUI.Toasts~Preview): normal flow, fixed width, no backdrop or positioning. Rows still hover; clicks fire their callbacks but there is nothing to close.

docs.summary: Render a menu panel at an absolute screen position on a caller-chosen `layer`, with a caller-owned `close` action. Unlike [`Show`](#api~Prowl.OrigamiUI.ContextMenu~Show) this adds no backdrop and no modal push, so the caller controls focus/dismissal and stacking. Used by menu bars that keep the bar itself above their own dropdown.
